args.title: Update password reset email to use correct base URL
args.body:
Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email links to a localhost URL. The current implementation in src/notifications/templates.ts sets the BASE_URL to http://localhost:3000 if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes issues for users, as the link in the email does not point to a valid production URL.

To fix this, we will update the BASE_URL to ensure it points to the correct public domain when sending the password reset email, instead of defaulting to localhost.
